name: Taima
subtitle: A private home for your cannabis collection.
description: Taima keeps track of the bags, prerolls and jars you collect from Dutch regulated coffeeshops. It reads labels on your iPhone, tracks your stash and stays offline.

apps.name: Taima
apps.subtitle: Your cannabis collection, private and offline.
apps.localizedDescription: Photograph a bag and Taima reads the label on your iPhone: strain, THC, weight, dates, grower and codes. Track your stash with a Live Activity, see stats and insights, browse a strain library with lineage, and keep everything on your phone with Face ID and discreet mode.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Taima in Dutch: Set your iPhone to Dutch and Taima speaks it too, from the labels to the widgets.
• Repeat last session: Log the same amount and method again in one tap, from Stash, a bag or the widget.
• Log from the Home Screen: The bag-in-use widget comes in a medium size with all quick amounts.
• A calendar of your use: Stats shows each month at a glance: days with use, shaded by amount, and days without.
• On this day: See what you collected around this date in earlier years.
• Roulette and games: Spin for a strain, a way to smoke and a game like Bim Bam Baap. Add players, keep score, chase rare legendary pulls and make every rule your own, in Tools.
• Strain sources: Every curated lineage now shows where it comes from. Growers and sources update with the strain library.

• Cleaner label photos: Taima straightens and crops the bag in your photo, evens out the light and reads both versions.
• Better label reading: More label layouts, dates and weights are understood, and every filled-in value can be checked.
• Improve older entries: Re-read the bags you already have and accept what the better reader adds. Nothing you typed is changed.
• A bigger strain library: Many more curated strains, aliases and crosses, and the library now updates itself.
• Timed notes: Write how a session is going, with an optional photo, from the bag, the Stash or the Live Activity.
• Learns your fixes: When you correct a name Taima misread, it remembers on this iPhone. You can choose to share samples to help everyone.
• Updates and reminders: Add Taima's source to SideStore for automatic updates. Taima tells you about new versions and reminds you the day before a refresh is due.
• Clearer milestones: Tap a badge in Stats to see what earns it, where to do it and how far along you are.
• Countdown to 4/20: Tools now counts the days to 20 April, next to the daily 4:20.
• Undo and polish: Take back a stock change, a removed session or a deleted note. Taima asks before discarding edits, and layout, contrast and wording are clearer throughout.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Taima uses the camera to photograph bag labels. Photos and text recognition stay on this iPhone.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Taima uses Face ID to unlock the app when you turn on the lock.
